lyrics:
[verse]
Bruno panted in the heat,
Named after me? Oh, what a treat!
Kiki laughed, they're named for stars,
The Dog Star shines, not you, superstar!
[chorus]
Dog days of summer, dog days of summer,
Hot, hot, hot, oh what a bummer!
Dog days of summer, dog days of summer,
Grab some shade, it's getting hotter!
[verse]
It means the hottest summer days,
When the sun has blazing rays,
Long ago, the Dog Star rose,
Sirius shone when summer glowed!
[chorus]
Dog days of summer, dog days of summer,
Hot, hot, hot, oh what a bummer!
Dog days of summer, dog days of summer,
Splash around and stay much cooler!
[outro]
So when it's hot and sticky, too,
The dog days of summer are here for you!
